title: A JDBC startup check can succeed without a validation query
summary: Startup now uses JDBC isValid(1) when no SQL is configured. An invalid first loan and a throwing first loan each closed before the second was validated.

change.description: DatabaseStartupValidator uses JDBC 4 Connection.isValid when no SQL is configured and retains the explicit validation-query path.

notes: Two distinct connection objects record acquisitions, timeout, calls and closes. The explicit SELECT 1 control records the statement close separately.
Each pin supplies its changed production classes on spring-jdbc 5.2.7.RELEASE. The replay verifies the loaded class origins and all class digests of each compiled slice.
